title: Large family child-care homes, by ZIP code
question: How many large family child-care homes are licensed in each ZIP code, and how often are they cited?
finding: 292 large family child-care homes are licensed in San Francisco with 4,028 places; 52 carry a Type A citation (21.9 per 100 homes, against 20.8 per 100 centres). 82 large-home licences in the file are closed.
how: State file of large family child-care homes (capacity over eight), San Francisco County, grouped by ZIP code; ZIP codes with fewer than five open homes merged.
limits: These are private homes: no home or licensee is named. The file covers large homes only; small family child-care homes are not in it. A home is visited less often than a centre, so fewer citations can mean fewer visits.

columns.t: Homes with a Type A citation

rows.zip: 9 ZIP codes with fewer than five open homes, merged

sources.t: California Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing facility list with visits, complaints and citations: family child care homes, more than eight children (file of 15 November 2026)
